description: Final summary NDJSON line emitted by `sqlite-graphrag enrich`. Always the last line. The 'summary' sentinel field distinguishes it from per-item events. Written from `EnrichSummary` in src/commands/enrich/events/summary.rs and kept equal to it by tests/enrich_status_schema_drift_gate.rs. Every optional member carries `skip_serializing_if = Option::is_none`, so an absent value is an ABSENT KEY and never an explicit null. enrich emits through `emit_json_line`, which is documented at src/output/stream.rs as the unshaped path, so this envelope never carries the agent-native `agent_surface`, `truncated` or `count` members. backend_invoked added in v1.0.84 by ADR-0042; retyped added in v1.2.8 by GAP-SG-279.

summary.description: Sentinel field; always true. Distinguishes this line from per-item events.

operation.description: Rust Debug format of the EnrichOperation variant (e.g. 'MemoryBindings', 'EntityDescriptions', 'BodyEnrich').

items_total.description: Total items discovered by the scan phase.

skipped.description: Items skipped (filtered out, abstained, or already satisfying the operation).

retyped.description: v1.2.8 (GAP-SG-279): entities whose type label was REWRITTEN this run, a subset of `completed`. Emitted only by `entity-type-validate`, and only when at least one label actually moved; absent everywhere else. Without it a caller could not tell a run that confirmed every label from one that rewrote them all, because confirmations land in `skipped` and rewrites in `completed`.

cost_usd.description: Cumulative LLM cost in USD. Zero for dry-run and OAuth runs.

backend_invoked.description: v1.0.84 (ADR-0042): embedding backend that ran the live embedding across this enrich run. Absent when enrich ran without embedding.

waiting.description: Items waiting on backoff with next_retry_at in the future (GAP-SG-15/16, v1.0.97).

dead.description: Items moved to the terminal dead-letter state (GAP-SG-15/23, v1.0.97).

budget_exhausted.description: v1.1.8 (GAP-CLI-EC-08): true when the soft/max runtime budget ended the run early. Absent when the run ended for any other reason.

pairs_remaining_estimate.description: v1.1.8 (GAP-CLI-EC-08): estimated pairs still unscanned (status proxy). Absent for operations that do not scan pairs.

yields.description: v1.1.8 (GAP-CLI-PRIO-05): cooperative yields performed this run. Absent when the run never yielded.

preempted_for_gate.description: v1.1.8 (EC-09): true when entity-connect yielded to hot entity-descriptions. Absent when no preemption happened.
